info.title: Lupin III - L'elusività della nebbia (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lupin è impegnato nella ricerca di un antico tesoro, quando viene trovato ed inseguito da Zenigata. Ma l'ispettore non è l'unico con cui dovrà vedersela, infatti, un uomo di nome Kyosuke Mamo, dotato di grandi poteri, è in grado di viaggiare nel tempo, e vuole vendicarsi della dinastia dei Lupin a causa di un vecchio torto subito. Durante un inseguimento, Lupin, Jigen e Goemon, iniziano a notare strani avvenimenti, tra cui la sparizione di ogni cosa attorno a loro, per poi ritrovarsi immersi in un'epoca del tutto differente... ed è a quel punto che scoprono di essere nell'epoca del Giappone feudale. Al nemico, però, Lupin e i suoi risultano molto utili al fine di scovare un antico tesoro che permette di viaggiare nel tempo, e che, una volta trovato, impedirebbe ai posteri di intraprendere viaggi temporali. La banda di ladri riuscirà quindi a tornare nella propria epoca sbarazzandosi del potente nemico?

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: On the ocean floor, Lupin is once again seeking a treasure hoping to get on Fujiko's good side. As Zenigata chases them on sea and land, people around the gang begin to vanish mysteriously. The fog rolls in and Mamo Kyosuke appears in a burst of light; he claims to be from the future and seeks revenge on Lupin III for what Lupin XIII has done to him. Mamo hurls Lupin, Jigen, Goemon, and Zenigata 500 years into the past; as two warring factions fight over a legendary shrine dedicated to time travel, Lupin must find a way to survive the past to ensure his future.

episodes.title: The She-Cat from France
episodes.synopsis: Cat’s Eye has hit Tokyo again but the Kisugi sisters are still in France! Hitomi, Ai, and Rui must stop the imposter, but the fake Cat’s Eye has her own agenda!

episodes.title: A Soaking Dance at Midnight
episodes.synopsis: Rui goes undercover to steal a painting, but things get messy when Toshio is sent over to the Organization Crime Division. Now Cat’s Eye has to get Toshio reinstated too!

episodes.title: Angels` Ransom
episodes.synopsis: A group of armed men kidnap children… and everyone thinks that Cat’s Eye is behind it! The three sisters have to get the paintings, take down the bad guys, and get the kids back!

episodes.title: A Scare in the Dark
episodes.synopsis: The unthinkable has happened and Toshio actually gets a good look at Cat’s Eye! Will Hitomi have to come clean and let Toshio arrest her? Or will she find a way to keep him in the dark?

episodes.title: The Hunter Wore a Badge
episodes.synopsis: After many failed attempts to catch Cat’s Eye, Special Investigations sends in the ruthless Chief Himuro. Can Cat’s Eye avoid Himuro, a man who is willing to kill for a perfect arrest record?

episodes.title: The Stolen "I Love You"
episodes.synopsis: After a burglar steals Toshio’s money, he gets kicked out of his apartment. He begs Hitomi to let him stay, but the burglar tracks him down and cleans out the Kisugi household!

episodes.title: The Good Life
episodes.synopsis: Toshio is enjoying his stay at the Kisugi household, but with a detective staying under their roof, Cat’s Eye can’t pull off their heists. The sisters concoct a plan to make Toshio leave.

episodes.title: The Magnificent Trap
episodes.synopsis: Cat’s Eye steals another of their father’s paintings, but it turns out to be a fake! In retaliation, the sisters set up a trap of their own to reclaim the painting.

episodes.title: Cap-race-io of Love
episodes.synopsis: After stealing a gem, Ai panics and hides it in Toshio’s police car. But Toshio’s car gets stolen by a young punk and Hitomi has to get both the car and gem back!

episodes.title: The Most Dangerous Game
episodes.synopsis: A thief is brought in for questioning, but Toshio can’t pin anything on him. Cat’s Eye has to find a way to get their father’s painting from the thief before he delivers it to the Mafia!

episodes.title: The Gift Is Dad`s Wine
episodes.synopsis: A man comes to the café claiming to be Heinz’s art teacher! He’s looking for a bottle of wine with a label drawn by Heinz, but something doesn’t seem right with the mysterious visitor.

episodes.title: A Mystery for a Winter Night
episodes.synopsis: Somehow, paintings stolen by Cat’s Eye have been sold back to their owners! Surely, one of the three sisters couldn’t be responsible… right?

episodes.title: Yokohama Bay Blues
episodes.synopsis: The painting Cat’s Eye is after ends up getting taken by the owner’s daughter, as she runs away from home! Ai has to catch her, but a dubious private eye has his own plans.

episodes.title: For You, the Tear of the Stars
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi poses as the daughter of a skilled gem cutter to get close to a band of jewel thieves. But with the Inunari Police targeting the thieves too, Hitomi may blow her cover!

episodes.title: Fake Wedding Bells
episodes.synopsis: Cat’s Eye plans to steal a statue of Mary from a church, so Toshio plans a sting operation—by holding a fake wedding! But can Hitomi be Toshio’s bride and be Cat’s Eye at the same time?

episodes.title: Beware of Sweet Invitations
episodes.synopsis: The owner of a gallery takes a strong interest in Hitomi, but his intentions seem far from innocent. Could this gallery owner be that dangerous?

episodes.title: Farewell, Winter Seagull
episodes.synopsis: When a sailor’s girlfriend somehow gets ahold of a gem that Cat’s Eye is after, she’s kidnapped! Hitomi teams up with the sailor to look for her.

episodes.title: The Woman the Chief Fell For
episodes.synopsis: The chief is head over heels for a beautiful woman. At the same time, a thief by the name of “Winter Firefly” has been eluding Inunari Police. Could the chief’s affair be related somehow?

episodes.title: The Inunari Police Triumvirate
episodes.synopsis: The police have a new computer to come up with security plans! The sisters will have to beat them to the punch and get the access codes from the chief, Asatani and Toshio.

episodes.title: Uneasy Feelings About a Transfer Student
episodes.synopsis: A new student comes to Ai’s school. He’s good looking, athletic, and intelligent…and has a prized violin that Cat’s Eye is after!

episodes.title: A Requiem for the Villains
episodes.synopsis: Cat’s Eye has been framed for murder! They’ll have to clear their name, steal the painting, and expose the bad guys!

episodes.title: Toshio Falls in Love with a Phantom Woman
episodes.synopsis: For their next heist, Hitomi puts on a disguise and tries to seduce Toshio. But things go a little too well and now Toshio is in love with the mystery woman!

episodes.title: Romance Out of the Blue
episodes.synopsis: A young artist is replacing works with expertly-crafted forgeries, but is it his fault? Rui goes undercover as a model but what will she do about her growing feelings for the young painter?

episodes.title: Enthusiasm Is a Must for April Fools`
episodes.synopsis: Toshio begs the sisters to pose as Cat’s Eye for a sting operation, but how can Cat’s Eye make their heist with the Inunari Police already there?

episodes.title: Capricious Scramble
episodes.synopsis: A young woman joins the police force and falls madly in love with Toshio. She’s cute and tenacious, and she may end up foiling Cat’s heist and Hitomi’s love life!

episodes.title: The Halftime of Love
episodes.synopsis: To avoid being caught, Hitomi and Rui hide a stolen gem in a football at Ai’s school. But when the ball gets used in a game, Cat’s Eye and the Inunari Police hit the field!

episodes.title: Don`t Cry, Inunari Trio
episodes.synopsis: After HQ brings in a new hotshot chief, the former chief, Toshio, and Asatani are demoted! Desperate to return to their old jobs, they plan to catch Cat’s Eye on their own!

episodes.title: Goodbye to My Mommies
episodes.synopsis: Toshio’s neighbor has an emergency and leaves her child with him. However, when he gets called in for work it’s up to Hitomi to babysit. Can Cat’s pull off a heist with a child in tow?

episodes.title: A Toast to Travel in the Golden Years
episodes.synopsis: An elderly couple is traveling in search of the “Japanese spirit.” Toshio is assigned as a bodyguard for them, but there may be more than it seems with this husband-and-wife duo!

episodes.title: Dancing Belongs in the Starry Skies
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi begins to doubt her relationship with Toshio. Can Hitomi and Toshio save their relationship and reconnect? And will that get in the way of Hitomi’s work as Cat’s Eye?

episodes.title: The Splendid Leotard
episodes.synopsis: A necklace that Cat’s Eye is after happens to be the prize for a contest called Miss Leotard. The sisters enter but they have a surprise challenger to contend with: Detective Asatani!

episodes.title: Head over Heels for Hitomi
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi gets close to an ex-convict to find out where he hid part of his stolen treasure. However, the man has two former partners and the location of the stash is inside Inunari Station!

episodes.title: Heartbreak over Cat`s
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi disguises herself as a man for a job. But after she saves a young girl and Detective Asatani from a bank robber, the two fall hopelessly in love with the disguised Hitomi!

episodes.title: To the Southern Cross, with Love
episodes.synopsis: The sisters travel to Saipan to track down an item from their father’s collection. They expect a fun beach trip but instead get tangled up in a dangerous trap!

episodes.title: Your True Face Is a Silhouette
episodes.synopsis: A gallery owner has supposedly caught Cat’s Eye on security camera and now intends to reveal the identity of Cat’s Eye to the world on a variety show! But is his analysis right?

episodes.title: Just One Chance to Steal
episodes.synopsis: An eccentric museum curator has a hobby of catching thieves and now he’s after Cat’s Eye! Hitomi will have to avoid many traps and tricks in his high-tech art museum.

episodes.title: Curtain Call of Love
episodes.synopsis: Ai writes a script about Cat’s Eye for her school and everyone wants in! As they say, art imitates life! How would Toshio respond if he found out his girlfriend was actually Cat’s Eye?

info.title: God Troubles Me
info.synopsis: Nel XXI secolo, il rapido sviluppo della società umana ha infranto l'equilibrio tra i regni degli umani, degli immortali e dei mostri. Su Moting è una ragazza comune che lavora nel mondo umano, ma è anche la "figlia di un immortale e di un mostro". Cacciata di casa dai suoi genitori, Su si unisce a un immortale e a un mostro, dando inizio a una vita quotidiana esilarante insieme a loro.

2036 - la scienza ha vinto la morte, grazie ad una nuova tecnologia medica basata su di nano macchine medicali ed al “Shell System”, ma solo i più ricchi ne hanno tratto giovamento. Yozo Oba non fa parte dell'élite ed è tormentato da strani sogni. Un giorno decide d'impulso di partecipare, insieme ad un suo amico capo di una gang di motociclisti, ad una sfortunata incursione nel “The Inside” (all'interno), ossia dove vivono i ricchi e potenti. Questo evento segna l'inizio di un viaggio ricolmo di terrificanti scoperte che cambieranno la vita di Yozo per sempre.

I due ragazzi decidono allora di unirsi alla squadra per migliorarla e riuscire a farla sorridere. La ragazza si rivela essere Yuri Nakao, figlia dell’allenatore della squadra di baseball, e i due scoprono che la squadra rischia di essere sciolta se non comincia a vincere. La serie segue i tre, insieme al lanciatore Eiji Kurahashi, mentre Niimi e Karasawa imparano il baseball e cosa significa essere uno dei nove giocatori in campo, lavorando insieme durante il liceo con l’obiettivo di arrivare al Kōshien.

info.title: Project A-ko
info.synopsis: A-ko è una ragazza dotata di forza e velocità sovrumane, che tiene sotto controllo attraverso degli speciali bracciali che indossa sempre; è inoltre una studentessa che vive a Graviton City, la città tecnologicamente più avanzata del mondo. A-ko dovrà barcamenarsi tra furiose rivalità scolastiche e...un'invasione aliena.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: A gigantic spaceship impacts in the center of an Earth city. 16 years later, a new metropolis has been built around the spire of the embedded spaceship. Young A-Ko is trying to cope with fitting into her new school and her motor-mouth friend C-Ko. The rich, stunning B-Ko tries to ruin the "new girl" by fighting her with giant robots, super exoskeletons and a girl who looks like Arnold Schwarzenegger in pony tails. Oh, did I mention that A-Ko has superpowers? Amidst her "normal" trials, A-Ko also has to deal with an alien armada trying to track down their lost princess.

info.title: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
info.synopsis: Il principe Cecil è talmente perfetto che ogni cosa gli riesce con facilità, tanto da annoiarlo. Ma al loro primo incontro, la sua promessa sposa, Lady Bertia, sostiene che quello in cui si trovano è il mondo di un otome game a cui stava giocando nella sua precedente vita. Nel gioco impersonava la cattiva e ha intenzione di rispettare la parte ed annullare il fidanzamento. Il principe non comprende ma decide di stare a guardare. La sua vita improvvisamente non è più così noiosa!

episodes.title: An Observation Log of Meeting a Self-Proclaimed Villainess.
episodes.synopsis: When Crown Prince Cecil is ten years old, he takes Bertia as his fiancée. She claims to have memories of her past life, and says that this is the world of an otome game she once played. She also says that she is a villainess. Cecil is generally bored, but her extraordinary statements spark curiosity in his heart.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of the Self-Proclaimed Villainess`s Debut into Society.
episodes.synopsis: Bertia struggles to correct the scenario she has unintentionally altered. At the same time, Cecil enters Halm Academy, a boarding school. During this time in which the two of them spend more and more time apart, Bertia's mother becomes pregnant and it leaves Bertia worried about one thing.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Entering School.
episodes.synopsis: Time passes and Bertia enrolls at Halm Academy, the same school as Cecil. At the same time, Heronia, the heroine of the otome game, also enrolls there. Wishing for a happy ending for Cecil, Bertia fights to bring the two of them together.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Love`s Cupid.
episodes.synopsis: In order for Cecil to find happiness with Heronia, avoiding the reverse harem route is essential. For that reason, Bertia has decided to become love's cupid, pairing Cecil's personal aide candidates with other noble ladies.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and First Feelings.
episodes.synopsis: Heronia grows impatient with the fact that the situation isn't unfolding according to the proper scenario and her attitude toward Bertia worsens. Since the moment Cecil left to study abroad, the harassment that Bertia faces, presumably spurred by Heronia, escalates by the day.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and the Resolution of the Matter.
episodes.synopsis: When Cecil learns that Bertia has been pushed down the stairs, he's assailed by an emotion he's never experienced before. Together with the members of the student council, he sets out to take retribution. They gather everyone in the courtyard in order to catch the true culprit.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Hatred.
episodes.synopsis: Upon advancing to the high school division, Bertia begins avoiding Cecil. After turning the situation over in his mind, Cecil visits his father in order to investigate the nature of the Maiden of Destiny. The fated day, the graduation ceremony, quickly approaches.

episodes.title: Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Being Struck Speechless.
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the graduation ceremony. Bertia is resolved to have the tables turned on her and be struck speechless just as the game scenario dictates, but Cecil has prepared something entirely different. Then Heronia speaks up, accusing the villainess Bertia of heinous crimes.

episodes.title: Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and a Doll.
episodes.synopsis: Cecil has been knocked unconscious by the light spirit, Pii-chan, who makes him live in a what-if world in a realm of pure consciousness. The Cecil of that world, where everything unfolds according to the game's original scenario, is as cold and emotionless as a doll, and as Cecil experiences that for himself, his own consciousness begins drifting closer to that of a doll, too.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and Cecil Glo Alphasta.
episodes.synopsis: Cecil wakes after witnessing Pii-chan vanish into nothingness, but Bertia's anxiety hasn't abated even though the judgement event is over. Cecil convinces Bertia to tell him about the different routes the future takes in the game scenario.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess and the Royal Family.
episodes.synopsis: At last, Cecil and Bertia commit themselves to each other in the truest sense, but the problem of how to deal with Heronia still remains. In order to keep his promise to Pii-chan, Cecil confronts Heronia.

episodes.title: An Observation Log of a Self-Proclaimed Villainess as a Wife.
episodes.synopsis: It's been two years, and the day of Cecil and Bertia's wedding ceremony has arrived. Believing that Bertia deserves to be the happiest bride in the world, Cecil works hard to fulfill her every wish. Watched over by family and friends, their ceremony proceeds in a way that is uniquely their own.

info.title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne
info.synopsis: L'impero di Adresia, sul continente Vogel, possiede un vasto territorio e una potente milizia ed è al momento al centro di una battaglia per il trono. I figli dell'imperatore lottano per espandere il loro potere, tuttavia tra di loro ce n'è uno, che di certo non salirà al trono: il settimo principe, Arnold Lakes Adler, inferiore in tutto rispetto al suo gemello. Incompetente e letargico, Arnold passa le sue giornate a sprecare il suo tempo. In realtà, in gran segreto, è uno degli unici cinque avventurieri di classe SS. Totalmente disinteressato a regnare, quando la battaglia per il trono si fa più intensa, prende la sua decisione per aver salva la vita: tramare affinché sia il suo gemello a diventare imperatore.
